subject: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — aligning windows & prompt pack
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — aligning windows & prompt pack

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the eval kickoff: 

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use case: clinical coding assistant for intake notes (80% of scope).
- Success metric: >= 92% label accuracy on the agreed prompt set and <150ms p95 latency for inference under pilot throughput.
- Data constraints: PHI will be scoped to redacted examples; Medicata prefers VPC/private deployment for pilot evaluation.

What we need to schedule now:
1) Evaluation kickoff (60–75 min) — technical deep dive + trial plan review + prompt set walk-through
2) Demo deep dive (30–45 min) focused on inference performance and integration options

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed Jan 18, 10:00–11:15 or 15:00–16:15
- Thu Jan 19, 09:00–10:15 or 13:30–14:45

Please let me know which window works for you and Jordan. I’ll invite the right folks from our side: Kimberly (solutions engineering) for the technical deep dive and Ben (customer success) for pilot logistics. I’ll also attach a short trial plan and the initial prompt pack for your review ahead of the call.

Attachments: RD_trial-plan_v1.pdf (1-pager), prompt-pack_initial.xlsx (10 sample prompts + evaluation rubric)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri y om.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@medicata.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — aligning windows & prompt pack

Thanks Priyom — useful recap. Wed Jan 18 at 15:00 PST works best for our team (Alex + Jordan). A couple asks before we lock: 

- Can you share the success-criteria checklist as a short doc (we need to align with our clinical QA team)?
- For the prompt pack: will you include a few edge-case examples (handwritten notes and abbreviations)? We can pre-label a small set for the eval.
- Do your trial plans assume private VPC from day one or can we run an initial hosted evaluation?

If you can send the trial-plan and prompt pack now (even draft) we’ll start prepping. Once we confirm, I’ll accept the invite.

— Alex
Director of Engineering | Medicata Health
alex.turner@medicata.com | +1 (617) 555-4490

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 18:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — align availability (internal)

Ben/Kimberly — FYI and quick ask: Alex/Jordan at Medicata confirmed Wed 1/18 at 15:00 PST for the kickoff. Can you both join? Key objectives for the session: 
- Kimberly: technical deep dive (inference perf, VPC option, data handling) — 30–40 min
- Ben: pilot timeline, success criteria, and metrics we’ll monitor — 15–20 min

Prep items (please upload to the shared Drive folder):
- A one-page success criteria checklist (template)
- Short note on VPC vs hosted pilot tradeoffs (bullet points)
- One-sentence owner for each action in the trial-plan

Attaching: I’ll send the draft trial-plan and prompt pack to Alex now.

Thanks — PD

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicata.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@medicata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — aligning windows & prompt pack

Alex / Jordan — thanks for confirming. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics) for Wed Jan 18, 15:00–16:15 PST. Drafts attached: RD_trial-plan_v1.pdf and prompt-pack_initial.xlsx. Highlights below so you can review quickly: 

RD_trial-plan_v1.pdf (high level)
- Goal: 3-week evaluation to validate accuracy and latency under pilot load
- Success criteria: >= 92% label match on blinded prompt set; latency p95 < 150ms; integration PoC with one staging endpoint
- Roles & owners: Medicata (data prep) / Redwood (model serving, prompt engineering, monitoring)
- Risk/mitigation: plan for prefix caching to improve latency, optional quantized model baseline for cost control

prompt-pack_initial.xlsx
- 42 sample prompts across 3 templates (standard intake, free-text clinician notes, abbreviated shorthand)
- Column for expected label, confidence band, and QA notes

Open Qs you raised: 
- Edge-case examples: included 6 handwritten-abbrev samples and flagged as "edge" in the prompt pack. Please add your pre-labels when convenient.
- VPC vs hosted: we can run initial 1-week hosted proof-of-concept to validate prompts quickly, then spin up a dedicated VPC pilot for the 3-week run. I put the recommended timeline in the trial-plan.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RD-2028-0567) and Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEvalPack).

If that all looks good I’ll send the invite and add a short agenda (kickoff -> tech deep dive -> success criteria + next steps).

Best,
Priyom

Attachments: RD_trial-plan_v1.pdf, prompt-pack_initial.xlsx, calendar-invite.ics

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@medicata.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jan 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff scheduling — aligning windows & prompt pack

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround, Priyom. We reviewed the draft and the timeline looks good. Jordan will pre-label a batch of 30 examples from the prompt pack by EOD Monday so you have something to run in the hosted smoke test. We accept the Wed 1/18 15:00 PST invite; see you then.

A couple small asks for the kickoff agenda: 
- Please include 10 minutes at the end for data ingestion/PII handling Q&A directed at our security lead (they may join briefly).
- Can you share the expected deliverables at the end of the 3-week pilot (format & ownership)? Maybe a short checklist in the meeting notes.

— Alex
